claims.title: FeMoCo ground-state energy resource estimate via spectral amplification and DFTHC (Low et al., 2025)
claims.headline: FeMoCo's ground-state energy could be estimated with about 3.2 million physical qubits in roughly 2.7 hours.

claims.title: FeMoCo 76-orbital (Li) ground-state energy resource estimate via spectral amplification and DFTHC (Low et al., 2025)
claims.headline: The ground-state energy of FeMoCo's larger 76-orbital (Li) active space could be estimated with about 4.5 million physical qubits in roughly 8.6 hours.
